general.description: This base is coupled to the Biimis border station, the two conjointly guarding the border on the Sshaad side between Baartish and Arythem spaces. Of course, the two States are formally allies and jointly maintain the Joint Peacekeeper Corps, but marauders, smugglers and pirates exist on both sides. Estiis serves as a abse and outpost for the elite pilotes that assists Biimis station. It is of notice that the base is named after the colored stripes that show on some Sshaads' articulations. If the lore is to be believed, they are the marks of the gifted, signalling particularly talented individuals. It is told that an unusual number of young Masters appointed to that station indeed attained high-ranking positions afterwards, but no-one ever formally studied that fact, so it may well be another urban legend !
